name: JobSpy
description: Multi-source job board scraper that aggregates job postings from LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, Google Jobs, Bayt, and Naukri into structured data

tools.name: job_search
tools.description: Search for job postings across multiple job boards simultaneously. Returns structured job data including title, company, location, salary, and job URL.

search_term.description: Job title, keywords, or skills to search for. Supports Boolean operators (AND, OR) and exact match with quotes.

location.description: Geographic location (city, state) or 'Remote' for remote positions

site_name.description: List of job boards to search

results_wanted.description: Number of job results to retrieve per site (max ~1000)

hours_old.description: Filter jobs posted within the last N hours

distance.description: Search radius in miles from the specified location

linkedin_fetch_description.description: Fetch full job descriptions for LinkedIn (slower but more detailed)

proxies.description: List of proxy servers for avoiding rate limits

examples.description: Search for Python developers in NYC
examples.python:
from jobspy import scrape_jobs
jobs = scrape_jobs(search_term='python developer', location='New York, NY', results_wanted=10)
examples.cli: python jobspy_cli.py --search 'python developer' --location 'New York, NY' --results 10 --format json

examples.description: Find remote data analyst jobs posted in last 24 hours
examples.python: jobs = scrape_jobs(search_term='data analyst', is_remote=True, hours_old=24, results_wanted=20)

examples.description: Search Indeed and Glassdoor for PM jobs
examples.python: jobs = scrape_jobs(site_name=['indeed', 'glassdoor'], search_term='project manager', location='DC', results_wanted=25)

tools.name: list_supported_sites
tools.description: Get list of all supported job board sites

sites.indeed: Indeed.com - Best coverage, no rate limiting
sites.linkedin: LinkedIn Jobs - Requires proxies for best results
sites.google: Google Jobs - Aggregates from multiple sources

tools.name: list_supported_countries
tools.description: Get list of supported countries for Indeed/Glassdoor

bd_intelligence.description: Business Development intelligence gathering through job market analysis
examples: Identify companies with growth signals (high hiring volume)
Track specific target accounts for BD opportunities
Analyze market demand for specific skills

cis_mapping.description: CIS labor category mapping from job descriptions
examples: Match job descriptions to labor categories

chatgpt_integration.recommended_approach: Use the CLI wrapper (jobspy_cli.py) for ChatGPT code execution
chatgpt_integration.output_format: JSON is recommended for LLM parsing
chatgpt_integration.rate_limiting_notes: Indeed has no rate limiting. LinkedIn requires proxies for sustained use.
best_practices: Start with Indeed for reliable results
Use hours_old to get recent postings
Request JSON format for structured output
Limit results_wanted to 20-50 for quick responses
